title: ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE KOREA NATIONAL DEFENSE UNIVERSITY
full_text:
ACT ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE KOREA NATIONAL DEFENSE UNIVERSITY

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to establish the Korea National Defense University and provide for matters regarding the operation of the University to promote the education, research, analysis, and development of sciences on national security policies and national defense management, and to train professional human resources to take charge of affairs related to national security.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 2 (Establishment)
The Korea National Defense University shall be established under the jurisdiction of the Minister of National Defense.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 3 (Establishment of Graduate Schools, etc.) (1) The Korea National Defense University shall consist of the National Security Graduate School, the National Defense Management Graduate School, and the Department of Job Training.
  (2) The Korea National Defense University shall establish, within it, the Faculty Board and other necessary divisions.
  (3) Matters necessary for the organization, missions, operation, etc. of each Graduate School, the Department of Job Training, the Faculty Board, etc. referred to in paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 4 (Courses, Years Required for Graduation, etc.) (1) The Korea National Defense University shall establish basic non-degree courses (hereinafter referred to as "basic courses") and degree courses for a degree (hereinafter referred to as "degree courses") and may also establish special courses, if deemed necessary by the Minister of National Defense.
  (2) The number of years required to graduate from a basic course shall be one year, and the number of years required to graduate from a degree course shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree by applying mutatis mutandis Article 31 of the Higher Education Act, while the number of years required for graduation from a special course shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
  (3) Matters necessary for the operation of basic courses and degree courses and other relevant matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 5 (Qualification for Admission)
Persons qualified to enter the Korea National Defense University shall be classified as follows from among the persons selected from the Armed Forces, government agencies, or other institutions or organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree:
  1. A basic course: Persons who meet the qualification requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree;
  2. A degree course: Persons who meet the qualification requirements under Article 33 of the Higher Education Act and the qualification requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree;
  3. A special course: Persons who meet the qualification requirements determined by the Minister of National Defense.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 6 (Subjects) (1) The subjects of the basic course shall be those necessary for the formulation and execution of national security policies.
  (2) The subjects of the degree course shall be those necessary for scientific research on national security and national defense science, which shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense, subject to prior consultation with the Minister of Education.
  (3) The subjects of the special course shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 7 (Grant of Degrees, etc.)
A person who finishes a degree course shall be granted a degree and registered pursuant to Article 35 of the Higher Education Act, and the types of degrees shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense, subject to prior consultation with the Minister of Education.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 8 (Appointment of President, etc.) (1) The Korea National Defense University shall have one president and one vice president, and each Graduate School shall be headed by one dean, the Department of Job Training by one director, and the Faculty Board by one dean.
  (2) The Korea National Defense University shall have professors, associate professors, assistant professors (hereinafter referred to as "professors, etc."), and other public officials as necessary.
  (3) The president of the Korea National Defense University shall be appointed by the President upon recommendation by the Minister of National Defense from among general-level officers; and the vice president, the dean of each Graduate School, and the dean of the Faculty Board shall be appointed by the Minister of National Defense from among general-level officers or professors: Provided, That if the vice president, the dean of a Graduate School, or the dean of the Faculty Board is to be appointed from among professors, such position shall be filled by the Minister of National Defense upon recommendation by the president of the Korea National Defense University. <Amended by Act No. 14609, Mar. 21, 2017>
  (4) The term of office of the vice president, the dean of each Graduate School, and the dean of the Faculty Board shall be two years: Provided, That the foregoing shall not apply where a general-level officer is appointed to vice president, dean of a Graduate School, or dean of the Faculty Board. <Amended by Act No. 14609, Mar. 21, 2017>
  (5) Matters necessary for the appointment of the director of the Department of Job Training and his/her term of office, and other matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 9 (Appointment, etc. of Professors, etc.) (1) Professors, etc. in charge of education in degree courses shall be appointed from among persons who are qualified pursuant to Article 16 of the Higher Education Act. In such cases, professors and associate professors shall be appointed by the President upon recommendation by the Minister of National Defense, and assistant professors shall be appointed by the Minister of National Defense upon recommendation by the president of the Korea National Defense University.
  (2) Professors, etc. solely in charge of education in basic courses or special courses shall be appointed by the Minister of National Defense from among field-grade officers or civilian military employees who meet the qualification requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  (3) The President may delegate his/her authority to appoint professors and associate professors under paragraph (1) to the Minister of National Defense, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. 
  (4) Professors, etc. in charge of education in degree courses shall be appointed under contract, and the term of each appointment shall be as follows:
  1. Professors: Up to eight years;
  2. Associate professors: Up to six years;
  3. Assistant professors: Up to four years.
  (5) Where professors, etc. are appointed from among persons other than military persons or civilian military employees, such professors, etc. shall be deemed State public officials in specific service, and the Educational Officials Act and the Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers’ Status and the Protection of Their Educational Activities shall apply mutatis mutandis respectively to the remuneration, training programs, as well as the guarantee of status for such professors, etc., disciplinary action against such professors, etc., and appeals filed by such professors, etc. <Amended by Act No. 13936, Feb. 3, 2016>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 10 (Affiliated Institutions) (1) The Research Institute for National Security Affairs and a library as affiliated institutions shall hereby be established in the Korea National Defense University.
  (2) Matters necessary for the organization, missions, operation, etc. of the Research Institute for National Security Affairs and the library shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

Article 11 (Collection of Tuition Fees, etc.) (1) The president of the Korea National Defense University may charge tuition fees and other charges to executive officers or employees of institutions or organizations prescribed by Presidential Decree, who enter the Korea National Defense University.
  (2) Matters necessary regarding the tuition fees and other charges referred to in paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 12745, Jun. 11, 2014]

ADDENDA <Act No. 6017, September 7, 1999>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 2000.
Article 2 (Repeal of Another Act) The Act on the Establishment of the National Defense Graduate School is repealed.
Article 3 (Amendment of Another Act) The Military Personnel Management Act is amended as follows: In Article 8 (3), “National Defense Graduate School” is replaced by “Korea National Defense University”.
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Enrolled Students and Graduates)
(1) Persons enrolled, when this Act enters into force, in the National Defense Graduate School under the former Act on the Establishment of the National Defense Graduate School (hereinafter referred to as the “National Defense Graduate School”) shall be deemed enrolled in the Korea National Defense University under this Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea National Defense University”).
(2) Persons who graduated from the national security course of the National Defense Graduate School before this Act enters into force shall be deemed to have graduated from the basic course of the National Security Graduate School or the National Defense Management Graduate School of the Korea National Defense University.
(3) Persons who graduated from a master's degree course of the National Defense Graduate School before this Act enters into force shall be deemed to have graduated from the corresponding degree course of the Korea National Defense University.
Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Faculty and Staff)
(1) Faculty and staff of the National Defense Graduate School at the time this Act enters into force may be appointed as faculty and staff of the Korea National Defense University within its authorized staffing quota.
(2) For faculty and staff appointed under paragraph (1), their grades and salary steps at the National Defense Graduate School shall be recognized, and the date of their appointment at the educational institution to which they first belonged shall be deemed the date of their appointment under this Act.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 6400, January 29, 2001>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (46) omitted.
(47) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows: In Articles 6 (2), 7, and 9 (3), “Minister of Education” is replaced by “Minister of Education and Human Resources Development”, respectively.
Paragraphs (48) through (79) omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 7088, January 20, 2004>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That ... <omitted> ... portions amending Acts that were promulgated before this Act enters into force but have not yet entered into force, among the Acts amended by Article 6 of these Addenda, shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (172) omitted.
(173) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows: In Articles 6 (2) and 7, “Minister of Education and Human Resources Development” is replaced by “Minister of Education, Science and Technology”, respectively.
Paragraphs (174) through (760) omitted.
Article 7 Omitted.

ADDENDA (Higher Education Act) <Act No. 10866, July 21, 2011>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That ... <omitted> ... Article 3 of these Addenda shall enter into force one year after the date of promulgation.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (6) omitted.
(7) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows:
In Article 8 (2), “professors, associate professors, assistant professors, and full-time instructors” is replaced by “professors, associate professors, and assistant professors”.
In Article 9 (1), “by the Minister of National Defense upon recommendation, and full-time instructors by the president” is replaced by “by the Minister of National Defense upon recommendation”; subparagraph 4 of paragraph (4) of the same Article is deleted.
Paragraphs (8) through (27) omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.

ADDENDA <Act No. 11633, March 22, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability of Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers' Status) The amended provisions of Article 9 (5) shall apply beginning with professors, etc. who first take charge of education in degree courses after this Act enters into force.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 11690, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) (1) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) Omitted.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (140) omitted.
(141) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows: In Articles 6 (2) and 7, “Minister of Education, Science and Technology” is replaced by “Minister of Education”, respectively.
Paragraphs (142) through (710) omitted.
Article 7 Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 12745, June 11, 2014>
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers' Status and the Protection of Their Educational Activities) <Act No. 13936, February 3, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (3) omitted.
(4) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows: In Article 9 (5), “Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers' Status” is replaced by “Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers' Status and the Protection of Their Educational Activities”.
Paragraphs (5) through (8) omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.

ADDENDA (Military Personnel Management Act) <Act No. 14609, March 21, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force three months after the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>
Article 2 (Amendments of Other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (6) omitted.
(7) The Act on the Establishment of the Korea National Defense University is amended as follows:
In the main clause of Article 8 (3), “the president, from among general-level (將官級) officers” is replaced by “the president, from among general-level (將星級) officers”, and “the dean of the Faculty Board, from among general-level (將官級) officers” is replaced by “the dean of the Faculty Board, from among general-level (將星級) officers”; in the proviso to paragraph (4) of the same Article, “general-level (將官級)” is replaced by “general-level (將星級)”.
Paragraphs (8) through (19) omitted.
Article 3 Omitted.
